summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing a special dividend of $0.90 per share, with shareholders having the option to receive payment entirely in cash or entirely in common shares. The stock election price is $3.8821 per share, based on the 20-day VWAP through April 21, 2026. The record date is May 4, 2026, with payment expected on June 5, 2026. The board retains the right to pay entirely in cash. This is a capital-return event via a scrip dividend structure. Watch for shareholder election rates and any late change to all-cash payment to gauge cash preservation motives.
